usedFor: inflow-inventory holds purchasing and stock, and Slack asks someone to decide through “Send Interactive Message” on “New Sales Order Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sales Order Created” in inflow-inventory, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A new sales order reaches Slack with buttons or a form, so someone can approve it there.

watchOut: An automation's Slack post waits for approval today, so “Send Interactive Message” appears only after you approve it.
